description: Plain WebFetch of https://bank.gov.ua/ua/legislation returned HTTP 403 Forbidden. The site is clearly live (indexed, PDFs served from the same host appear in results), so this reads as WAF/bot filtering rather than a dead endpoint.

result.result_summary: 403 on the single most important URL in this cell; static /admin_uploads PDFs on the same host were returned by search normally.

why_it_matters: The origin node for every Ukrainian banking prudential deadline cannot be harvested with a naive HTTP client; collection design must assume a browser-context fetcher plus the zakon.rada.gov.ua mirror as fallback. Recorded as UNVERIFIED, not dead.

description: No confirmed RSS/Atom feed URL for the NBU news or legislation sections was located within this run; search returned the HTML listing (bank.gov.ua/en/news/all) and open-data API docs but no feed endpoint.

result.result_summary: RSS existence neither confirmed nor disproved.

why_it_matters: If no feed exists, near-real-time deadline detection requires polling and diffing HTML, which raises the cost and fragility of the collector for the highest-priority source.

description: No dedicated, machine-readable NBU register of effective dates / transition deadlines (a 'календар набрання чинності') was found. Effective-date information appears only inside the operative clauses of each act and in news items.

result.result_summary: Deadlines must be extracted from free text ('ця постанова набирає чинності з ...'), not read from a structured field.

why_it_matters: The A3 deadline workstream will need NLP/regex extraction over act texts rather than a lookup, and cross-validation against zakon.rada document metadata.

description: Official NBU English versions of resolutions appear partial; English content found was either NBU summary pages or third-party translations (cis-legislation.com) of uncertain currency.

result.result_summary: English coverage is derivative; Ukrainian is the only authoritative language for this cell.

why_it_matters: Any English-only pipeline would silently miss or misdate binding requirements; uk parsing is mandatory.

description: LIGA:ZAKON (ips.ligazakon.net) serves NBU resolution texts but behind session tokens/paywall; the search-surfaced URLs carry rnd/session parameters indicating non-stable, non-scrapable access.

result.result_summary: Rich amendment-chain data exists but is not lawfully or technically bulk-collectable without a licence.

why_it_matters: Amendment-chain tracking (which resolution changed which) may need a paid subscription or must be reconstructed from zakon.rada redaction history.

description: The NBU has no standalone '/legislation/drafts' or '/publicdiscussion' page. Both guesses returned HTTP 404 (/ua/legislation/drafts, /ua/about/publicdiscussion). Consultations are surfaced only through the tagged news stream (drafts_discussion) plus the /ua/regulatory-activity hub.

result.result_summary: Two plausible section URLs 404; the real entry points are /ua/regulatory-activity, /ua/regulatory-activity/planning and the tag-filtered news list.

why_it_matters: A collector designed around a 'consultations page' assumption will silently collect nothing. The tag+news architecture must be modelled explicitly.

description: Four candidate RSS endpoints on bank.gov.ua (/ua/rss, /ua/rss/all, /rss/all, /ua/news/rss) all returned HTTP 404.

result.result_summary: No RSS/Atom feed discovered for NBU news or consultations in this run.

why_it_matters: Collection must be HTML-scraping-based with change detection, which is more brittle and needs a monitoring alert when the page structure changes.

description: The tags=drafts_discussion query parameter is not consistently applied server-side: /ua/news?tags=drafts_discussion returned a generic 42-item news list including monetary-policy and numismatics items, while /ua/news/all?tags=drafts_discussion returned only 10 links. The tag is however reliably present on the detail page of a genuine consultation article.

result.result_summary: Tag filtering must be done client-side by the collector, on the detail page, not trusted from the list URL.

why_it_matters: Naively trusting the tag URL produces both false positives (unrelated news) and false negatives (missed consultations).

description: bank.gov.ua returns HTTP 403 to the WebFetch-class fetcher on every path tried, while returning HTTP 200 to curl with a desktop User-Agent on the same paths.

result.result_summary: Bot-defended, not dead. Hypothesis only — a deterministic verification pass should confirm.

why_it_matters: The single most important host in this cell would be wrongly marked dead by a naive liveness checker.

description: drs.gov.ua/regulatory_policy/ returned 403; mof.gov.ua/uk/proekti-aktiv-dlja-obgovorennja returned 403; kmu.gov.ua redirected to a validate.perfdrive.com ShieldSquare bot-check interstitial.

result.result_summary: Three adjacent Ukrainian government hosts refused plain HTTP clients in this run; all three are indexed and linked, so presumed live.

why_it_matters: These carry the oversight and methodology layer of the RIA process; collection needs a headless browser, not plain HTTP.

description: Two candidate Ukrainian financial-association domains failed at the network layer: uafic.com.ua (connection refused) and www.vaib.com.ua (DNS resolution failure). nabu.ua returned HTTP 429.

result.result_summary: No verified URL obtained for the finance-companies/insurance association layer in this run; these domain guesses may simply be wrong rather than the organisations being absent.

why_it_matters: Non-bank associations are the organised respondents to a large share of NBU consultations; leaving them uncovered biases the industry-reaction signal towards banks only.

description: No NBU page was found that publishes the received comments, the respondents, or the regulator's reasoned response to them ('звіт про результати обговорення' / feedback statement). The consultation notice states comments are accepted via a template to an address, but the responses do not appear to be published.

result.result_summary: Searched the regulatory-activity hub and a live consultation article; only inbound materials (draft, RIA, comparison table, comment template) were found — no outbound feedback statement.

why_it_matters: Without a published feedback statement, the only way to see who influenced a rule is to diff the consulted draft against the enacted act and to track association positions separately.

description: Searched in both Ukrainian and English for an adviser-maintained, structured compliance-DEADLINE TRACKER for Ukraine banking/payments (a calendar or table of 'rule → effective date → who is affected'). Nothing of that shape was found on any UA law firm or Big-4 Ukraine site.

result.result_summary: The closest artefact is PwC Ukraine's recurring 'Key NBU Changes in <month>' digest, which is prose segmented by regulated population rather than a dated tracker. All other firms publish episodic per-event alerts. Deadline information exists but must be extracted from prose.

why_it_matters: The A3 workstream cannot inherit a ready-made deadline calendar from advisers; it must construct one by parsing effective-date statements out of alerts. This raises the extraction burden and makes the PwC digest disproportionately valuable as the single periodic anchor.

description: Checked whether the international firms covering Ukraine (CMS, Wolf Theiss, Baker McKenzie, Kinstellar) publish Ukrainian-language versions of their UA regulatory alerts.

result.result_summary: Only Kinstellar was observed publishing a genuinely paired UKR/ENG edition (the Payment Services Law newsletter PDFs). CMS, Wolf Theiss and Baker McKenzie output on Ukraine appeared English-only in every result seen. Among domestic firms, Asters and Sayenko Kharenko do maintain uk/en mirrors.

why_it_matters: For uk-language terminology extraction the cell must lean on domestic firms (Asters, Sayenko Kharenko, Arzinger, INTEGRITES), PwC/KPMG Ukraine's uk trees and Kinstellar's paired PDFs; international firms are en-only signal and cannot anchor the glossary.

description: Attempted direct fetches of guessed hub paths sk.ua/uk/legal-alerts/ and sk.ua/en/publications/.

result.result_summary: Both returned HTTP 404. The homepage revealed the actual hub is https://sk.ua/uk/insights/ with a category filter ?cat=publications-uk, and article URLs are numeric IDs (sk.ua/uk/2937/) rather than slugs.

why_it_matters: Documents that Sayenko Kharenko cannot be crawled by slug construction — index scraping is mandatory — and is a reminder that 404s on guessed paths are a naming hypothesis failure, not evidence the source is dead.

description: Plain fetch of the PwC Ukraine tax-and-legal-alert index page.

result.result_summary: HTTP 403 Forbidden on the index, while individual PwC alert article URLs under the same tree surfaced normally through search in both en and uk. Treated as bot-defended-but-live; recorded as unverified, not dead.

why_it_matters: The highest-value periodic source in this cell needs a rendering/user-agent-capable collector rather than a naive HTTP client; planning for that now avoids wrongly writing off the source at verification time.

description: Searched for Ukraine banking/payments regulatory alerts from Aequo, Redcliffe Partners, Ilyashev & Partners and Eterna Law using Ukrainian-language terms.

result.result_summary: No banking/payments regulatory alert pages for these firms surfaced in the queries run. Their existence as ranked UA firms is corroborated indirectly (rankings coverage), but no alert feed was observed, so none is recorded as a candidate.

why_it_matters: Absence here is a search-coverage limitation, not proof these firms are silent — they are the natural next expansion set for this cell, best reached via the directory/ranking pointers rather than open web search.

description: No publicly published, chapter-by-chapter Ukraine screening report for Chapter 9 'Financial services' was located. Search returned news that screening completed in Sep 2025 and that bilateral Chapter 9 meetings occurred 13-14 February, but not a downloadable Commission screening report for that chapter.

result.result_summary: Only the annual country report SWD and news items were found; screening reports for Ukraine appear not to be published per-chapter at accessible URLs.

why_it_matters: Screening reports are the densest source of directive-level, forward-dated transposition obligations; absent them, the annual SWD plus the Ukraine Facility indicator list are the fallbacks.

description: No EPC or EU decision admitting Ukraine to the SEPA geographical scope was found. Status as of the searches: Ukraine adopted preparatory draft laws (Dec 2025) and is not a SEPA member; the latest EPC List of SEPA Scheme Countries located is v8.0 (2025-12).

result.result_summary: Ukraine's SEPA accession is pending, with domestic AML/CFT alignment legislation as the observable precondition.

why_it_matters: Any claim that Ukraine has joined SEPA would be false today; the EPC country-list version diff is the correct trigger to watch.

description: No formal EBA–NBU memorandum of understanding, and no ECB Opinion specifically addressing Ukrainian legislation, was located in these searches.

result.result_summary: Cooperation appears to be programme-level and informal so far; NBU describes strengthening interaction with EBA/EIOPA/ECB but no signed instrument surfaced.

why_it_matters: Signing such an instrument would be a strong, datable convergence signal; its absence should be recorded as 'not found', not as 'does not exist'.

description: The EEAS-hosted EU-Ukraine Association Agenda PDF surfaced at a legacy path (eeas.europa.eu/ukraine/docs/st06978_15_en.pdf) which predates the EEAS site migration and may redirect or 404.

result.result_summary: URL recorded as a candidate example but unverified; a current copy likely exists on consilium.europa.eu or the Ukrainian government EU portal.

why_it_matters: Collection should resolve the Association Agenda from a stable host rather than a legacy path.

description: The EPC Register of Participants was referenced from the EPC 'Be Involved' page but its exact register/download URL was not pinned down in this pass.

result.result_summary: Register exists and is the granular adherence dataset; direct URL to be resolved at collection time.

why_it_matters: It is the highest-resolution indicator of Ukrainian PSP entry into SEPA schemes once scope is extended.

description: No evidence found in this pass of a BIS/Basel Committee RCAP (Regulatory Consistency Assessment Programme) jurisdictional assessment covering Ukraine.

result.result_summary: Searches on Basel Core Principles / Basel implementation returned only generic BCBS, FSB and IMF/WB FSAP methodology material, none Ukraine-specific. Ukraine is not a BCBS member jurisdiction, so RCAP coverage is a priori unlikely; Basel implementation in Ukraine is instead assessed indirectly via IMF/NBU reporting and EU-acquis alignment.

why_it_matters: Prevents the run from expecting a BIS-published Ukraine assessment that probably does not exist; redirects Basel-implementation tracking to NBU regulatory acts and IMF programme documents.

description: No Ukraine-specific FSAP report was located in this pass.

result.result_summary: Queries returned only FSAP programme-level documentation (IMF factsheet, World Bank 2021 FSAP review, handbook). A dedicated Ukraine FSAP publication was not surfaced; if one exists it is likely dated pre-2022 and would sit in the IMF country report series.

why_it_matters: FSAP is a named element of this coverage cell; if no recent Ukraine FSAP exists, the Basel Core Principles assessment channel for Ukraine is effectively dormant and should not be monitored as a live stream.

description: No stable Ukrainian-language landing page for MONEYVAL's Ukraine jurisdiction documents was found — the Council of Europe publishes in English (and French), and Ukrainian versions exist only as ad-hoc unofficial translations posted by MoF/FIU.

result.result_summary: uk-language searches surfaced translations and commentary, not an official uk index.

why_it_matters: Ukrainian-language monitoring of MONEYVAL must be done via fiu.gov.ua and mof.gov.ua rather than coe.int; a uk-only collector would miss the primary documents entirely.

description: fatf-gafi.org was not fetched during this pass.

result.result_summary: The FATF site is commonly WAF/bot-protected; no fetch was attempted, so its accessibility for automated collection is unknown.

why_it_matters: Collection design should assume FATF may need a browser-based or low-rate fetch strategy; a single 403 during verification must not be read as the source being dead.

description: Direct regulatory-coverage articles from ain.ua and Forbes Ukraine (forbes.ua) did not surface in any of the six searches run, despite both being named in the coverage cell.

result.result_summary: Only outlet homepages were returned; no NBU/consultation-specific item from either domain appeared in results.

why_it_matters: Their regulatory coverage density is unproven for this cell; a collection pipeline should validate whether they publish enough regulation/deadline items to justify a dedicated feed, or whether they are better treated as occasional-interview sources.

description: No dedicated paid or free email newsletter devoted specifically to Ukrainian banking/payments regulation deadlines was identified.

result.result_summary: The closest substitutes found are the UAFIC/FinTech Ukraine Telegram channel, law-firm legal alerts, and vendor blogs; no equivalent of a subscription regulatory-tracking bulletin surfaced.

why_it_matters: The cell brief anticipates 'specialist newsletters'; in practice Ukraine's equivalent function is carried by Telegram channels and association mailings, which require different collection tooling (Telegram web preview, mailing-list subscription) than RSS.

description: This slice was compiled from search-engine result data; no page was independently fetched, so no URL here is claimed as verified/reachable.

result.result_summary: All URLs are provided as candidates for the deterministic liveness pass. Section paths for epravda.com.ua, ain.ua, forbes.ua, delo.ua and thepaypers.com were partly inferred from site structure.

why_it_matters: Downstream verification must not treat these as confirmed live; inferred section paths in particular may 404 while the outlet itself is healthy.

description: Russian-language Ukrainian finance media (a residual but real segment, e.g. RBC-Ukraine's /rus/ edition) were not systematically searched because the run scope specifies uk and en only.

result.result_summary: One /rus/ URL appeared incidentally via rbc.ua; no dedicated ru-language sweep was performed.

why_it_matters: Some Ukrainian outlets still publish regulatory explainers first in Russian; a ru pass could surface earlier timestamps on the same story.

description: Searched in Ukrainian and English for a dedicated NBU landing page collecting top-management speeches and presentations (analogous to a BIS 'central bankers' speeches' section).

result.result_summary: No dedicated current-site section was identified. Speeches, interviews and briefing texts appear to be published as ordinary items in the general news feed at bank.gov.ua/ua/news/all, distinguishable only by formulaic title prefixes ('Виступ', 'Промова', 'Інтерв'ю', 'Пресбрифінг'). A legacy category 'Інтерв'ю та виступи' exists on old.bank.gov.ua but its liveness is unverified.

why_it_matters: Collection must rely on title-pattern filtering over a high-volume mixed feed rather than a clean per-type endpoint, which raises both false-positive and miss risk and should be reflected in the collector design.

description: Attempted to fetch the NBU news feed with a tag filter to enumerate available filter categories.

result.result_summary: HTTP 403 Forbidden on https://bank.gov.ua/ua/news/all?tag=promova. Search engines index the same host freely, so this reads as bot defence on the fetch path rather than a dead or moved resource.

why_it_matters: The single most important source in this cell is bot-defended. Collection needs browser-like headers, rate limiting, or a headless browser; a naive HTTP collector will silently return nothing and be misread as 'no new speeches'.

description: Looked for verbatim transcripts or full recordings of conference panels where NBU officials preview rules (UAFIN.TECH, Fintech & Payments Forum, banking summits).

result.result_summary: No transcript source was found. Evidence of what was said on stage exists only as third-party recaps (Scroll.media, Banker.ua, Finclub) and occasional organiser video. NBU press briefings are the exception — those are streamed on YouTube.

why_it_matters: The richest weak signals in this cell are spoken and unindexed. Without ASR over event video, the pipeline captures agenda topics and journalists' selections but not the officials' actual forward-looking statements.

description: Local-language searching on 'НАБУ' for the banking association.

result.result_summary: The acronym НАБУ overwhelmingly returns the National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine, an unrelated law-enforcement body. The banking association (formerly 'Незалежна асоціація банків України', renamed 'Національна асоціація банків України' as of 22 October) shares the acronym and sits at nabu.ua.

why_it_matters: Any keyword-based collection or entity resolution using 'НАБУ' without a domain constraint will be heavily polluted. Resolve this entity by domain (nabu.ua) only.

description: Attempted to confirm a current-year edition and programme for the Ukrainian Financial Forum (uff.icu, organised by ICU), named explicitly in the cell brief.

result.result_summary: The site and a 2021 archive page were found, but no current-edition programme was confirmed via search. Whether the forum ran in the current cycle is unresolved.

why_it_matters: A flagship named source may be dormant. Recording it as active without checking risks a permanently silent collector that looks healthy.

description: Searched for the canonical site of the National FinMon Forum and its organisers (Ukrainian Compliance Association, LIGA ZAKON).

result.result_summary: The forum was only reachable through third-party coverage; no organiser event page or canonical forum domain was identified in this run.

why_it_matters: AML/financial-monitoring supervision is a major A3 topic and this circuit is currently covered only indirectly through one media outlet, creating single-point dependency.

description: Searched in Ukrainian for a consolidated, machine-readable NBU register of applied enforcement measures ('перелік застосованих заходів впливу'). Found only recurring narrative monthly news releases (mostly AML/FX-framed) and no evidence of a structured downloadable dataset or a consumer-protection-specific sanctions list.

result.result_summary: Enforcement data for this cell appears to exist only as prose news items plus, indirectly, as decisions appealed into the court register.

why_it_matters: Any time series of conduct-related sanctions will have to be built by NLP over news text and by cross-matching appeals in ЄДРСР, not by downloading a register; that changes the collection design and cost.

description: https://bank.gov.ua/ua/consumer-protection returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to a programmatic fetch during this run, while the same content appears live in search results and a mirror path new.bank.gov.ua/ua/consumer-protection is indexed.

result.result_summary: Hypothesis: bot-defended but live. Not recorded as dead.

why_it_matters: Collection for the highest-priority publisher in this cell needs a browser-grade fetcher or the new.bank.gov.ua path; a naive crawler would silently record the regulator as unavailable.

description: Searched in Ukrainian for an operating Ukrainian financial ombudsman publishing dispute outcomes. Found only the long-pending legislative model (bill on the institution of financial ombudsman, registered 2018, No. 8055) and World Bank recommendations; no evidence of a live ombudsman body publishing decisions as of this run.

result.result_summary: No ADR-body decision stream exists for Ukraine comparable to a FOS-style publisher.

why_it_matters: Removes what would normally be the richest dispute-outcome source in this cell and concentrates all signal in NBU complaint reports plus the court register; also makes the ombudsman bill itself a high-value watch item for a future source.

description: The English seed query on NBU consumer protection/enforcement returned almost exclusively US regulators (CFPB, FDIC, OCC) and no Ukrainian primary sources.

result.result_summary: English-language discovery is near-useless for this cell; Ukrainian terms carried essentially all the yield.

why_it_matters: Confirms that ongoing monitoring must be built on Ukrainian keyword sets; an English-only pipeline would produce a false-empty result for Ukraine.

description: Every attempted direct fetch of bank.gov.ua (supervision/payment-services) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to the plain fetch tool.

result.result_summary: 403 on the regulator's own domain; PDFs under /admin_uploads/ and /files/ appeared in search indexes, so the site is presumed live and bot-defended rather than dead.

why_it_matters: The single most important source in this cell cannot be collected with a naive HTTP client; the pipeline needs a browser-based fetcher or the collection will silently under-report the primary regulator.

description: Could not pin the canonical URL for NBU Board Resolution No. 81 of 25.07.2025 (authorisation of non-financial payment service providers) or for the NBU draft-regulations consultation listing page.

result.result_summary: Both are attested by secondary sources (law-firm briefings; NBU-hosted draft PDF at /admin_uploads/article/proekt_pr_2026-05-26.pdf) but the exact landing URLs were not observed in this run.

why_it_matters: Resolution 81 defines the TPP authorisation gate and the 31.12.2025 / 01.01.2027 deadlines; the consultations page is the cell's earliest-warning channel. Both must be resolved by hand before automated collection.

description: No machine-readable (API/CSV/open-data) endpoint for the Payment Infrastructure Register (Реєстр платіжної інфраструктури) was located in this run.

result.result_summary: The register is described in NBU news and supervision pages, but only HTML/PDF presentation was evidenced; no data.gov.ua dataset was confirmed.

why_it_matters: Tracking who holds a payment-services licence over time is the backbone of vendor/acquirer market intelligence; without a structured feed this needs scraping plus snapshot diffing.

description: The NBU-approved open banking technical API specification itself was not found as a published document.

result.result_summary: Sources indicate the NBU has up to 18 months from Resolution 80 (25.07.2025) to approve the technical specification, and that legal-entity account specs were still being finalised by the Open API Group.

why_it_matters: The specification is the artefact that actually binds vendors; its publication date is the key event to watch in this cell over the next collection cycles.

description: No documented REST/JSON API returning an individual bill card (проходження, committee conclusions, reading dates) was found. The open-data portal exposes the bill register as periodically refreshed dataset files under /open/data/zpr, not as a per-bill query endpoint.

result.result_summary: Searched the Rada open-data portal catalogue and API documentation page; found dataset passports and CSV/JSON/XML file downloads only.

why_it_matters: Near-real-time stage tracking will require HTML scraping of Card pages in addition to the bulk datasets, which raises fragility and rate-limit risk; the collection design must budget for both paths.

description: Committee висновки/рішення appear as file attachments on bill cards and in committee meeting materials, but no single searchable index of banking/payments committee conclusions was located.

result.result_summary: The committee site exposes decisions, protocols and stenograms by meeting rather than by subject; retrieval is per-meeting or per-bill.

why_it_matters: Any conclusions corpus must be assembled by crawling meetings and bill cards; a topic query alone will not retrieve it.

description: The Verkhovna Rada English site publishes only selected news items; there is no English mirror of the bill register, bill cards, or the legal database.

result.result_summary: English seed query returned Rada English news articles and NBU English releases, but no English bill-search surface.

why_it_matters: All A3 pipeline collection for Ukraine must be built on Ukrainian-language sources; English is only a reporting/terminology layer. Downstream translation must be planned in.

description: «Офіційний вісник України» full text is distributed through commercial channels rather than as an open searchable archive; publication dates are practically obtained from the document card on zakon.rada.gov.ua instead.

result.result_summary: Search returned the legal framework (Presidential Decree No. 503/1997) and commercial ОВУ distributors, not an open ОВУ archive.

why_it_matters: Entry-into-force computation should rely on the zakon.rada.gov.ua document card's publication reference rather than on the gazette itself.

description: Opendatabot was named in Ukrainian-language material as a bill-monitoring service, but no specific Opendatabot legislative-monitoring product URL was confirmed in this pass, so it is not listed as a candidate.

result.result_summary: Query mentioned it; results did not resolve to a verifiable legislative-monitoring endpoint.

why_it_matters: Avoids recording an unverified source; flagged for a targeted follow-up rather than invented.

description: I found no free, standalone official web portal for «Офіційний вісник України» itself. The gazette is founded by the Ministry of Justice and published by ДП «Українська правова інформація»; its issues are distributed as a paid print/CD/online subscription via ДП «Преса» (indices 40433 and 48345). No 'ovu.gov.ua' style official free full-text site surfaced in Ukrainian-language searching.

result.result_summary: Authoritative gazette text is a paid product; the free authoritative substitute for publication dates is the zakon.rada.gov.ua b19 publication index plus the Minjust register.

why_it_matters: A3 deadline tracking depends on the publication timestamp. If verbatim gazette text is ever required for legal certainty, budget and licensing must be planned; otherwise the pipeline must rely on the rada/Minjust surrogates and label them as such.

description: A WebFetch of https://zakon.rada.gov.ua/laws/main/b19 (the gazette publication index) returned a 'socket hang up'. This is a connection-level failure consistent with bot defence, not evidence that the page is dead.

result.result_summary: Page treated as live-but-defended and unverified; the URL is recorded with reduced confidence, not dropped.

why_it_matters: The single most important free source in this cell may need a headless browser or realistic headers to collect; the collection design should assume that from the start.

description: Seed-adjacent searching for a single Ukrainian government-wide consultation portal (an equivalent of a 'regulation.gov.ua') did not surface one. Draft regulatory acts are instead published decentrally: each ministry runs its own 'Повідомлення про оприлюднення проєктів регуляторних актів' page, with ДРС (drs.gov.ua) acting as the oversight and digest layer.

result.result_summary: No single consultation aggregator identified; coverage must be assembled per-ministry plus the DRS digest.

why_it_matters: A3 consultation-deadline tracking cannot rely on one endpoint; the collector needs a per-ministry registry of consultation feeds.

description: I found no documented public API returning gazette issue contents or official publication dates as structured data. The parliament's open data portal (data.rada.gov.ua) offers XML/JSON/TXT legislation bundles and data.gov.ua carries a Minjust register dataset, but neither was confirmed to expose an issue-by-issue gazette feed.

result.result_summary: Bulk open-data exports exist; a purpose-built gazette API does not appear to.

why_it_matters: Publication-date extraction will require parsing act cards or bulk datasets rather than a clean API, raising maintenance cost and staleness risk.

description: English-language searching against the Cabinet of Ministers and Ministry of Finance produced only a partial EN mirror (kmu.gov.ua/en/npasearch, /en/news) and no English gazette. Official English texts of CMU resolutions and MinFin orders were not found.

result.result_summary: English is a navigation aid only in this cell; all substantive collection must be Ukrainian-language.

why_it_matters: Any downstream English-only analysis of Ukrainian executive acts would be operating on unofficial renderings; translation must be an explicit pipeline step with provenance kept.

description: Direct HTTP fetch of fiu.gov.ua (Держфінмоніторинг reporting-forms page) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden with no body.

result.result_summary: The FIU portal appears bot-defended rather than dead — it is indexed, actively referenced by third parties, and has an English mirror. Recorded as unverified/blocked, not offline.

why_it_matters: The single most deadline-dense non-NBU source for banks and PSPs cannot be collected with a plain fetcher; a headless-browser path or open-data/mirror fallback must be budgeted.

description: Searched in Ukrainian for a non-NBU consumer-protection supervisor over banks (Держпродспоживслужба, АМКУ).

result.result_summary: Держпродспоживслужба's own publications state that supervision of banks' compliance with financial-services consumer-protection law and financial advertising (outside the stock market) belongs to the National Bank of Ukraine.

why_it_matters: The cell brief assumed 'consumer-protection rulings on financial services' would be a non-NBU stream; for banks it largely is not. Retail-conduct enforcement must be tracked in the NBU cell, and this cell should not double-count it.

description: Searched (uk) for an AMCU public-consultation / draft-regulatory-act portal analogous to the NSSMC's регуляторна діяльність section.

result.result_summary: No dedicated AMCU consultation portal surfaced; draft amendments (e.g. to the Положення про концентрацію) appear only as ordinary news items on amcu.gov.ua, and cross-body coverage sits with the Державна регуляторна служба.

why_it_matters: AMCU consultation deadlines are only discoverable via unstructured news monitoring plus DRS, which raises miss risk for merger-rule changes affecting bank M&A.

description: Looked for a searchable, full-text AMCU decision database (as opposed to dated news bulletins).

result.result_summary: Only news-style summaries of decisions and разпорядження were found on amcu.gov.ua, plus legacy query-string listing URLs. No open, queryable decisions register was located in this pass.

why_it_matters: Full reasoning on bank/acquiring cases has to be recovered indirectly from the court register or trade press, which adds latency and interpretation risk.

description: No public, machine-readable register of designated critical infrastructure objects in the banking/financial sector was located. NBU Resolution No.69/2025 and Regulation No.178/2022 define criteria for designation, but the resulting list appears to be restricted-access.

result.result_summary: Only the criteria documents surfaced; no register endpoint or downloadable list.

why_it_matters: Without the register, one cannot tell which banks/PSPs are inside the heavier SSSCIP-linked compliance perimeter, which is the key segmentation variable for compliance-driven demand.

description: CERT-UA/SSSCIP financial-sector threat products are frequently TLP-marked and circulated to constituents rather than published; the public site shows aggregate statistics and TLP:CLEAR reports only.

result.result_summary: Public artefacts found were TLP:CLEAR analytics and news; sector-specific advisories to banks were not publicly enumerable.

why_it_matters: The most operationally specific requirements reach banks through closed CSIRT channels, so open-source monitoring will systematically lag the real compliance signal.

description: No URL in this slice was fetch-verified. Several are known to be bot-defended or paywalled (ligazakon, lexology) and zakon.rada.gov.ua often rate-limits automated clients.

result.result_summary: All URLs recorded from search-result metadata; liveness left to the deterministic verification pass.

why_it_matters: A 403 from these hosts must be read as bot defence, not as a dead source.

description: The acronym 'НБУ' collides with Незалежна асоціація банків України ('НАБУ', also the anti-corruption bureau NABU) in Ukrainian search results, and 'кіберзахист' vs 'кібербезпека' vs 'інформаційна безпека' are used inconsistently across SSSCIP and NBU acts.

result.result_summary: Queries needed disambiguating co-terms (постанова Правління, Держспецзв'язку) to avoid anti-corruption-bureau noise.

why_it_matters: Automated collection keyed on these acronyms will pull large volumes of irrelevant material.

description: Every automated fetch of bank.gov.ua (both /ua/supervision/registers and /ua/... paths) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, as did the data.gov.ua organisation HTML page.

result.result_summary: No page body retrieved from the NBU site during this scout. Content is nonetheless search-indexed and cross-referenced by law firms and press, so the hypothesis is bot defence (WAF/Cloudflare-style) rather than removal. NOT recorded as dead.

why_it_matters: Collection design for this cell must assume browser-emulating fetch or a headless browser for bank.gov.ua, and the CKAN API rather than HTML for data.gov.ua. A naive scraper will silently collect nothing.

description: No stable, directly-citable download URL for the Реєстр платіжної інфраструктури (Register of Payment Infrastructure) file itself was located from search results.

result.result_summary: Searches in Ukrainian for the register name plus 'xlsx'/'завантажити' surfaced the landing page, the governing NBU regulation and press coverage, but no confirmed file link. By contrast the DRFU register file path (bank.gov.ua/files/N_bank/r_drfu/ree_fu.xlsx) was reported via a data.gov.ua resource description.

why_it_matters: The RPI is the single most important register for this run's payments scope; its collection endpoint must be resolved by rendering https://bank.gov.ua/ua/supervision/payment-services/reg-ps in a real browser before the pipeline is built.

description: No separate public register listing authorised open-banking TPPs (AISP/PISP) as its own artefact was found.

result.result_summary: Legal and industry sources consistently state that TPPs are authorised as providers of non-financial payment services and are entered into the general Register of Payment Infrastructure, receiving an electronic certificate for bank API access — i.e. the open-banking population is a subset of RPI, not a standalone list.

why_it_matters: Any expectation of a discrete 'TPP register' page would produce a false negative. Open-banking actor tracking must be implemented as a filter over the RPI plus NBU licence-grant news, with Ukraine's open banking framework live since 1 August 2025 and bank API compliance due in early 2026.

description: EDR open-data publication was suspended during the war and only restored on 19 January 2026 under a Ministry of Justice order of 18 November 2025, with wartime-risk redactions.

result.result_summary: Access exists again but the dataset is not a like-for-like restoration of the pre-2022 content; some fields are withheld for security reasons.

why_it_matters: Historical continuity of ownership data for Ukrainian banks and PSPs is broken across 2022-2025; any longitudinal ownership analysis needs to flag that gap rather than infer change.

description: Local-language (uk) search was used for the majority of queries in this cell and was decisively more productive than English.

result.result_summary: Ukrainian queries surfaced the KIS NBU system, the regulation.gov.ua function catalogue, the legacy old.bank.gov.ua directories, the DRFU dataset resource path and the FGVFO sub-registers — none of which appeared in the English-language result sets, which returned mostly law-firm commentary.

why_it_matters: Confirms the mandate: an English-only scout of Ukrainian registers would have missed the actual data surfaces and returned only secondary commentary.

description: No dedicated e-money issuer register or card-scheme/processor list was separately identified beyond the RPI.

result.result_summary: Ukrainian terms for e-money issuers (емітент електронних грошей) and payment-infrastructure service operators were noted in the regulation.gov.ua function description but not chased to a distinct published list within this cell's budget.

why_it_matters: Leaves a residual possibility that a discrete e-money or processor sub-register exists as a separate NBU page; should be resolved when the RPI page is rendered.

description: Two WebFetch attempts against nabu.ua (the /ua/ homepage and /ua/vihidni-listi-nabu.html) both returned HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.

result.result_summary: No page content retrieved from nabu.ua by direct fetch; all NABU URL structure in this slice was reconstructed from search-engine result titles and slugs, which show many distinct live pages.

why_it_matters: NABU is the single most important actor in this cell. A 429 is a rate-limit/bot-defence signal, NOT evidence the site is dead — the collector must use a slow, well-behaved crawler with a real user agent and backoff rather than marking these sources unreachable.

description: https://ukbs.org.ua/ (Український кредитно-банківський союз, named in the cell brief) failed DNS resolution: getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND ukbs.org.ua.

result.result_summary: Could not reach the UKBS site at all. Search results still present ukbs.org.ua as the official site, and third-party sources (Wikipedia uk, ua-region EDRPOU 21573585, jurliga) confirm the organisation exists and takes regulatory positions.

why_it_matters: One of the four named actors could not be characterised from its own site. This is a hypothesis (resolver/egress issue or lapsed domain), not a verdict; the deterministic liveness pass must re-test from a different network before the source is retired, and a fallback via legal-news coverage should be kept either way.

description: No dedicated 'positions / comments on draft acts' section was located on fintechua.org (UAFIC) despite two searches, one of them in Ukrainian.

result.result_summary: UAFIC's regulatory engagement is evidenced (round tables with regulators, joint working groups, participation in preparing draft laws, the Sept-2021 open-banking memorandum with NABU and other associations) but appears to be published as news items and event material, not as a structured consultation archive.

why_it_matters: For UAFIC the collector cannot rely on a stable submissions page and must instead run text mining over the news feed and Telegram channel, which is noisier and needs different extraction rules.

description: The acronym НАБУ is severely overloaded: in this cell it means the banking association, but nationally it overwhelmingly denotes Національне антикорупційне бюро України (the National Anti-Corruption Bureau). The association itself is inconsistent, rendering its own name as both 'Незалежна асоціація банків України' and 'Національна асоціація банків України' across page titles on the same site.

result.result_summary: Bare 'НАБУ' queries risk being dominated by anti-corruption-bureau news; the association must always be queried with a qualifier such as 'асоціація банків' or the nabu.ua domain.

why_it_matters: Left unhandled this would poison both search-based discovery and any downstream entity resolution or deduplication in the collected corpus.

description: The payments association is written ЄМА (Ukrainian) and ЕМА (Russian/legacy) and EMA (Latin), with the domain ema.com.ua serving both www and bare-host variants and both /about/ and /about-association/ paths.

result.result_summary: All three spellings return relevant results; the site itself mixes URL patterns.

why_it_matters: Query sets and deduplication keys must cover all three spellings, or coverage of the payments-side association will be silently partial.

description: No RSS/Atom feed, sitemap, or open API was confirmed for any of the four named association sites during this pass.

result.result_summary: Fetches returned rendered HTML only; feed discovery was not possible for nabu.ua (429) and was not surfaced for ema.com.ua, aub.org.ua or fintechua.org.

why_it_matters: Collection design must assume HTML scraping with slug-series enumeration (which the NABU monitoring and EMA news numbered series make feasible) rather than feed subscription; a targeted /feed, /rss, /sitemap.xml probe should be part of the verification pass.

description: None of the six named banks appears to operate a dedicated 'regulatory change / compliance' page that names the driving NBU act. Regulatory drivers surface only incidentally inside tariff and public-offer amendment notices.

result.result_summary: Searches in uk for 'комплаєнс', 'вимоги регулятора', 'вимоги НБУ' on bank domains returned tariff/terms notices and marketing news, not a compliance-notice section.

why_it_matters: Collection must be built around terms/tariff amendment feeds plus regex for regulatory citations, not around a compliance page that does not exist.

description: Bank notices usually state an effective date but not the underlying NBU resolution. The clearest counter-example found is Raiffeisen citing p.17 of NBU Board Resolution No.18 of 24.02.2022 for suspended Western Union transfers.

result.result_summary: Across PrivatBank, Oschadbank, OTP, Ukrsibbank and Universal Bank notices seen in results, the wording is 'changes to Rules/Tariffs effective from DATE' without a legal citation.

why_it_matters: Linking bank action to a specific rule will mostly require inference against the NBU timeline rather than direct extraction; expect a matching step, not a parsing step.

description: Monobank/Universal Bank, and Ukrainian OTP/Ukrsib subsidiaries have no standalone Ukrainian investor-relations page; investor-grade disclosure exists only at parent-group level (RBI, OTP Group, BNP Paribas) or via NBU-mandated reporting.

result.result_summary: Searches surfaced RBI group IR pages but no raiffeisen.ua / ukrsibbank.com / universalbank.com.ua IR section.

why_it_matters: The cell's 'IR pages' assumption holds only for parent groups; Ukrainian-entity signal must come from press/notice pages and NBU disclosure instead.

description: Several listing-page URLs (https://www.oschadbank.ua/news, https://www.otpbank.com.ua/about/news/, https://www.universalbank.com.ua/news, https://about.pumb.ua/presscenter/notifications, https://nabu.ua/ua/novini-nabu.html) were inferred from item-level URLs returned by search rather than fetched directly.

result.result_summary: Item URLs under these paths were confirmed present in search results; the parent listing paths themselves were not fetched in this pass.

why_it_matters: The deterministic liveness pass should confirm these listing endpoints and their pagination parameters before crawler configuration.

description: Tariff-change news for state banks (notably Oschadbank) is heavily replicated by low-quality clickbait aggregators (pmg.ua, znaj.ua, tehnofan, ukrainianwall, my.ua clusters) which distort dates and amounts.

result.result_summary: A uk query on Oschadbank tariff changes returned mostly aggregator rewrites rather than the bank's own notice.

why_it_matters: Any collection pipeline needs a domain allowlist favouring bank primary sources plus minfin/finclub, or effective-date data will be corrupted.
